activities.title: A difficult recommendation
activities.content: When a neighbourhood council invited suggestions for a new park, Elise proposed converting an unused parking lot into a garden. Her first presentation highlighted cleaner air and more green space but ignored the effect on nearby businesses. A shop owner challenged her assumptions, explaining that deliveries depended on the lot. Elise initially felt defensive, then visited the businesses and gathered more evidence. She revised the plan to include a smaller garden and a designated delivery area. Not everyone welcomed the compromise, but the council agreed to test the layout for three months before making a final decision.
activities.question: How did Elise improve her proposal?
accepted_answers_json: she considered affected businesses and revised the proposal
activities.explanation: Elise responds to new evidence by modifying the proposal rather than dismissing concerns.
